sample_unit: GPT-4 responses (14 questions on each of 56 medical notes)

links.outcome: Physician agreement with GPT-4 responses on medical notes, stratified by note language
links.effect: Both physicians agreed with GPT-4 in 88% (86/98) of Spanish, 84% (82/98) of Italian, and 77% (454/588) of English responses; non-English performance was not worse.
links.quote: Both physicians agreed with GPT-4 more often for medical notes written in Spanish (86 [88%, 95% CI 79-93] of 98 responses) and Italian (82 [84%, 75-90] of 98 responses) than in English (454 [77%, 74-80] of 588 responses).

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation assessing the accuracy of GPT-4 in extracting information and answering clinical questions from multilingual medical notes evaluated by physicians, without evaluating a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
